ArcGISMapServiceInfo.description: The metadata for an ArcGIS map service.

Attribution.description: Gets the map service's copyright information.

Capabilities.description: Gets the capabilities supported by this map service, such as export, data, and query operations.

DocumentInfo.description: Gets the document information, such as the title, author, and comments.

ExportTileCacheCompactV2Allowed.description: Gets a value indicating whether exporting tiles in compact version 2 format (.tpkx) is supported.

ExportTilesAllowed.description: Gets a value indicating whether exporting tiles in compact format (.tpk) is supported.

FullExtent.description: Gets the full extent of the map service.

InitialExtent.description: Gets the initial extent of the map service.

MaxExportTilesCount.description: Gets the maximum number of tiles supported for exporting tiles.

MaxImageHeight.description: Gets the max height supported for an image export.

MaxImageWidth.description: Gets the max width supported for an image export.

MaxRecordCount.description: Gets the maximum number of records that will be returned at once for a query

MaxScale.description: Gets the maximum scale for the map service.

MinScale.description: Gets the minimum scale for the map service.

SupportedImageFormatTypes.description: Gets the list of supported image format types.

SupportsDynamicLayers.description: Gets a value indicating whether the ArcGIS map service supports dynamically defined layers.

TileInfo.description: Gets the information about the map tile cache if the map service is cached.

TileServers.description: Gets the tile servers that allow distributing load to multiple endpoints (optional)

TimeInfo.description: Gets the time information for a time-enabled map service.

TableInfos.description: Gets the collection of table infos that represent tables of the service.

Unit.description: Gets the unit map service uses for it's default spatial reference.

ServiceSourceType.description: Gets the service type of the service info.

SingleFusedMapCache.description: Gets a value indicating whether the ArcGIS map service has a single fused map cache.

SpatialReference.description: Gets the SpatialReference of the map service.

Source.description: Gets the ArcGIS REST service endpoint.

MapServiceCapabilities.description: Describes the capabilities of an ArcGIS map service, including whether it supports exporting map images, data and query operations.

SupportsData.description: Gets a value indicating whether the map service supports data operations, such as find, query, and related records.

SupportsMap.description: Gets a value indicating whether the map service supports map operations, such as exporting map images and listing all layers and tables.

SupportsQuery.description: Gets a value indicating whether the map service supports query operations, such as identify and access attachment data.

SupportsTilemap.description: Gets a value indicating whether the map service supports tiles.

SupportsTilesOnly.description: Gets a value indicating whether the map service supports tile requests only.

ServiceDocumentInfo.description: Contains detailed metadata information about an ArcGIS Server MapServer when a map service is published. Some of the document information for the service include: title, author, keywords, whether to use anti-aliasing on graphics, etc..

AntialiasingMode.description: Gets the anti aliasing mode of the document information.

Author.description: Gets the author of the document information.

Category.description: Gets the category of the document information.

Comments.description: Gets the comments of the document information.

Keywords.description: Gets the keywords of the document information.

Subject.description: Gets the subject of the document information.

TextAntialiasingMode.description: Gets the text aliasing mode of the document information.

Title.description: Gets the title of the document information.

AntialiasingMode.description: An enumeration of various antialiasing modes.

TextAntialiasingMode.description: An enumeration of various text antialiasing modes.

Dpi.description: Gets the DPI (dots per inch) that the tile cache has been generated for.

LevelsOfDetail.description: Gets the levels of details contained in the map cache.

Origin.description: Gets the origin (upper left corner) of the tiling scheme.

SpatialReference.description: Gets the spatial reference of the map cache.

TileHeight.description: Gets the height of each tile, in pixels.

TileWidth.description: Gets the width of each tile, in pixels.

Format.description: Gets the format of the tile images.

LevelOfDetail.description: A ImageTiledLayer has a number of LODs (Levels of Detail). Each LOD corresponds to a map at a given scale or resolution.

Level.description: Gets the ID for the level. The top most level is 0.

Resolution.description: Gets the resolution in map units of each pixel for the level.

Scale.description: Gets the scale for the level.

allOf.description: Represents a location defined by x and y (and optionally z) coordinates.

X.description: Gets the x-coordinate for the map point.

Y.description: Gets the y-coordinate for the map point.

Z.description: Gets the z-value for the map point.

M.description: Gets the optional coordinate to define a measure value for the point.

HasZ.description: Gets a value indicating whether the geometry has a z-value.

HasM.description: Gets a value indicating whether the geometry has an m-value.

IsEmpty.description: Gets a value indicating whether or not the geometry is empty.

Extent.description: Gets the minimum enclosing envelope of the instance.

GeometryDimension.description: Indicates the dimensionality of a Geometry, relating to the number of spatial dimensions in which the geometry may have a size.

Geometry.description: Base class for all classes that represent geometric shapes.

HasCurves.description: Gets a value indicating whether the geometry has any curves.

SpatialReference.description: Gets the spatial reference of this geometry.
Instances of this class specifies how geometry coordinates relate to real-world space.

IsGeographic.description: Gets a value indicating whether this is a geographic coordinate system.

IsPannable.description: Gets a value indicating whether the coordinate system is horizontally pannable.

IsProjected.description: Gets a value indicating whether the spatial reference is a Projected Coordinate System.

BaseGeographic.description: Gets the base geographic coordinate system if this is a projected coordinate system.

Unit.description: Gets the unit of measure for this spatial reference system.

VerticalUnit.description: Gets the unit of measure for the vertical coordinate system of this spatial reference.

Wkid.description: Gets the well-known ID for the horizontal coordinate system, or 0 if the spatial reference has a custom horizontal coordinate system.

VerticalWkid.description: Gets the well-known ID for the vertical coordinate system (VCS), or 0 if the spatial reference has no VCS or has a custom VCS.

WkText.description: Gets the well-known text for the horizontal and vertical coordinate system.

WkText2.description: Gets the well-known text for the horizontal and vertical coordinate systems as defined by the OGC standard.

HasVertical.description: Gets a value indicating whether spatial reference has a vertical coordinate system set.

Resolution.description: Gets the minimum distance that separates unique x,y coordinate values when stored in an ArcGISFeatureTable.

Tolerance.description: Gets the minimum distance that determines if two x,y coordinates are considered to be at the same location for relational and topological GeometryEngine operations.

VerticalResolution.description: Gets the minimum distance that separates unique z-values when stored in an ArcGISFeatureTable.

VerticalTolerance.description: Gets the minimum distance that determines if two z-values are considered to be at the same location for GeometryEngine operations that compare z-values.

Unit.description: Defines a base class for units of measurement.

Wkid.description: Gets the well-known ID for the unit, or 0 for a custom unit.

Name.description: Gets the name of the unit.

Abbreviation.description: Gets the abbreviation of the unit.

DisplayName.description: Gets the display name of the unit.

PluralDisplayName.description: Gets the display name of the unit.

allOf.description: Represents a linear unit of measure used by a Geometry or SpatialReference, or in measurement conversion functions.

TileImageFormat.description: The image formats supported by ArcGIS tiled map services.

DefaultInterval.description: Gets the default amount of time to use as an interval when stepping through the service's features by time

TimeWindow.description: Gets the service's default time window

HasLiveData.description: Gets a value indicating whether the service has live data.

TimeRelation.description: Gets the value that indicates how the start and end time of the time slider extent are processed.

TimeExtent.description: Gets the temporal window that includes all the data in the service

Duration.description: Gets the numeric quantity of time represented by the TimeValue instance.

Unit.description: Gets the temporal unit to apply to the specified Duration.

TimeZone.description: Gets the name of the time zone.

RespectsDaylightSavings.description: Gets a value indicating whether the time reference respects daylight savings time.

TimeExtent.description: Represents either a span between a defined start and end time or a particular instant in time.

IdInfo.description: A handle that represents the sub layer metadata for a Feature service or a Map service.

ServiceType.description: An enumeration of various types of web services.

MapServiceImageFormat.description: The image formats supported by ArcGIS map services and ArcGIS image services.

ArcGISSublayer.description: The base class for ArcGIS sublayer classes such as ArcGISMapImageSublayer, ArcGISTiledSublayer, and SubtypeSublayer.

Id.description: Gets an id that uniquely identifies this sublayer instance.

Sublayers.description: Gets the collection of sublayers of this sublayer.

MaxScale.description: Gets the maximum scale at which this sublayer is visible.

MinScale.description: Gets the minimum scale at which this sublayer is visible.

DefinitionExpression.description: Gets a SQL statement where clause that stipulates a subset of features to be displayed.

Opacity.description: Gets the opacity of this sublayer.

ScaleSymbols.description: Gets a value indicating whether this sublayer renders its symbols based on scale.

LabelsEnabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether labels should be displayed on this sublayer.

IsPopupEnabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the PopupDefinition defined is enabled.

PopupDefinition.description: Gets or sets the popup definition for the sublayer.

CanChangeVisibility.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer content's visibility can be changed.

IsVisible.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the sublayer content is visible.

Name.description: Gets the name of the sublayer.

ShowInLegend.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the sublayer participates in the legend.

SublayerContents.description: Gets a read-only collection of ILayerContent for this sublayer.

ArcGISMapServiceSublayerInfo.description: The metadata of an ArcGIS map service sublayer.

Source.description: Gets the endpoint URL of the ArcGIS Map Service for the sublayer.

DisplayFieldExpression.description: Gets the layer's display field expression, or null if the default display field is used.

GeometryType.description: Gets the GeometryType of features in the sublayer.

HasM.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer has m-values.

HasZ.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer has z-values.

MinScale.description: Gets the minimum scale at which the sublayer is visible.

MaxScale.description: Gets the maximum scale at which the sublayer is visible.

EffectiveMinScale.description: Gets the effective minimum scale at which the sublayer is visible.

EffectiveMaxScale.description: Gets the effective maximum scale at which the sublayer is visible.

DefaultVisibility.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer is visible by default.

HasAttachments.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer supports attachments.

DisplayFieldName.description: Gets the name of this sublayer's display field (displayField).

TypeIdFieldName.description: Gets the name of the sublayer's type ID field (typeIdField).

Fields.description: Gets a list of field definitions for the sublayer.

FeatureTypes.description: Gets a list of feature types for the sublayer.

MaxRecordCount.description: Gets the maximum number of records that can be returned by query, find, and identify operations on this sublayer.

CanModifyLayer.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer supports modifying its renderer and/or its data source.

SupportsStatistics.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer supports statistical functions in query operations.

SupportsAdvancedQueries.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer supports advanced queries, such as order-by fields.

HasLabels.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer has labels defined on it.

CanScaleSymbols.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer renders its symbols based on scale.

IsDataVersioned.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer has versioned data.

OwnershipBasedAccessControl.description: Gets the sublayer's ownership-based access control information.

UseStandardizedQueries.description: Gets a value indicating whether the sublayer requires the use of standardized queries.

SublayerInfos.description: Gets a collection of sublayer IDs.

RelationshipInfos.description: Gets a list of RelationshipInfo of sublayer.

FeatureSubtypes.description: Gets a list of FeatureSubtype of this layer.

DefaultSubtypeCode.description: Gets the layer's default subtype code.

ArcGISMapServiceSublayerType.description: The type of sublayer in the ArcGIS map service.

ArcadeExpression.description: An Arcade expression object, containing an expression, a name, a return type and a title.

Title.description: Gets the title that the author uses to describe the expression.

Name.description: Gets the name that the author uses to refer to the expression.

ReturnType.description: Gets the expected return type of the expression.

ArcadeExpressionReturnType.description: The expected type of the result calculated by an expression described within an ArcadeExpression

LayerTimeInfo.description: Defines various temporal settings on a feature service layer.

EndTimeField.description: Gets the name of the end time field.

HasLiveData.description: Gets a value indicating whether there is live data.

StartTimeField.description: Gets the name of the start time field.

Interval.description: Gets the default temporal interval to use when stepping through the layer's data by time

TimeReference.description: Gets the information about the time reference used for time values in the layer.

TrackIdField.description: Gets the name of the track ID field.

TimeExtent.description: Gets the temporal range that encompasses all the layer's data

DrawingInfo.description: Provides various information on how to render features in a feature layer.

LabelingInfo.description: Gets a list of LabelingInfo of this drawing info.

Renderer.description: Gets the renderer attached to this drawing info.

ScaleSymbols.description: Gets a value indicating whether symbols should be scaled.

ShowLabels.description: Gets a value indicating whether labels should be displayed.

LabelingInfo.description: Defines the text, appearance and position of labels for features for a given scale range.

LabelExpression.description: Gets the simple expression describing how to build the text label for a feature, often using attributes of the feature.

LabelPlacement.description: Gets the preferred position of the text label, with respect to its feature geometry.

MaxScale.description: Gets the largest viewing scale at which labels should be visible. If set, labels will disappear when the view is zoomed in beyond the maximum scale.

MinScale.description: Gets the smallest viewing scale at which labels should be visible. If set, labels will disappear when the view is zoomed out beyond the minimum scale.

UseCodedValues.description: Gets a value indicating whether label should use coded values.

Where.description: Gets the where clause used to filter which features will be labeled.

LabelingPlacement.description: An enumeration of labeling placement options, which is used to determine where the label for a feature should be positioned.

Renderer.description: A base class for renderers that use a collection of one or more symbols to display features in a Layer or graphics in a GraphicsOverlay.

RotationExpression.description: Gets or sets the expression describing how GeoElement's attributes are translated into a rotation to be applied to the GeoElement.

RotationType.description: Gets or sets whether the rotation calculated from the RotationExpression is relative to the screen or map.

SceneProperties.description: Gets or sets the scene properties for the renderer.

RotationType.description: The RotationType enum controls the origin and direction of rotation given by the rotation expression.

RendererSceneProperties.description: Collection of properties for renderers that participate in a Scene.

ExtrusionExpression.description: Gets or sets the extrusion expression.

ExtrusionMode.description: Gets or sets the extrusion mode.

HeadingExpression.description: Gets or sets the heading expression.

PitchExpression.description: Gets or sets the pitch expression.

RollExpression.description: Gets or sets the roll expression.

ExtrusionMode.description: The options for handling extrusion values.

Field.description: Contains information about an attribute field in a Feature

FieldType.description: Gets the data type of field.

IsEditable.description: Gets a value indicating whether field is editable.

IsNullable.description: Gets a value indicating whether field is nullable.

Length.description: Gets the length of the field.

Name.description: Gets the name of the field.

Domain.description: Specifies the set of valid values for a Field.

Name.description: Gets the name of the domain.

FieldType.description: Gets the field type of the domain.
The data format of an attribute field.

FeatureType.description: Defines the domains and feature templates that are used to create a new feature.

Id.description: Gets the ID of the feature type.

Domains.description: Gets the associated Domains with this feature type.

Name.description: Gets the name of the feature type.

Templates.description: Gets a list of FeatureTemplate of the feature type.

FeatureTemplate.description: Defines the default attribute values for the fields of a newly created ArcGISFeature and suggests a type of drawing tool to sketch the feature's geometry.

Description.description: Gets the description of the feature template.

DrawingTool.description: Gets the type of drawing tool that could be used to draw this feature in an editing application.

Name.description: Gets the name of the feature template.

PrototypeAttributes.description: Gets the default attribute values used when creating a Feature

DrawingTool.description: An enumeration of available drawing tools.

OwnershipBasedAccessControlInfo.description: Defines the ownership-based access control settings of a feature service.

AllowOthersToDelete.description: Gets a value indicating whether others are allowed to delete features.

AllowOthersToQuery.description: Gets a value indicating whether others are allowed to query features.

AllowOthersToUpdate.description: Gets a value indicating whether others are allowed to update features.

AllowAnonymousToDelete.description: Gets a value indicating whether anonymous users are allowed to delete features.

AllowAnonymousToUpdate.description: Gets a value indicating whether anonymous users are allowed to update features.

RelationshipInfo.description: Defines information about the relationship between tables.

Cardinality.description: Gets the cardinality of this relationship.

Id.description: Gets the ID of this relationship.

IsComposite.description: Gets a value indicating whether this is a composite relationship.

KeyField.description: Gets the key field, the field that links the origin and destination tables of this relationship.

KeyFieldInRelationshipTable.description: Gets the key field in the relationship table.

Name.description: Gets the name of the relationship.

RelatedTableId.description: Gets the ID of the related table.

RelationshipTableId.description: Gets the ID of the relationship table. The default value is -1, indicating that no table exists.

Role.description: Gets the role that this table has in this relationship.

RelationshipCardinality.description: An enumeration of the different cardinalities of feature table relationships.

RelationshipRole.description: An enumeration of the different roles of Feature Table relationships.

FeatureSubtype.description: Describes a subset of features in an ArcGISFeatureTable that share the same integer attribute value.

Name.description: Gets the name of the feature subtype.

PrototypeAttributes.description: Gets the prototype for creating a Feature with this subtype.

FieldOverrides.description: Gets the fields defined for this feature subtype.

PopupDefinition.description: Defines the appearance and format of popups. Also includes which fields to display.

AllowDelete.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the popup should allow the associated GeoElement to be deleted.

AllowEdit.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the popup should allow the associated GeoElement to be edited.

AllowEditGeometry.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the popup should allow the geometry of the associated GeoElement to be edited.

Description.description: Gets or sets a string that appears in the body of the popup window as a description.

Fields.description: Gets a mutable list of PopupField which defines how each field participates in the pop-up window.

Media.description: Gets a mutable list of PopupMedia which defines images and charts displayed in the pop-up window.

ShowAttachments.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether attachments will be loaded for layers with attachments.

ShowEditSummary.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the popup should display the edit summary of the associated GeoElement.

Title.description: Gets or sets a string that defines the popup's title.

RelatedFeaturesDefinition.description: Gets or sets the related features definition.

Expressions.description: Gets a collection of PopupExpression defining the various arcade expressions on the popup.

Elements.description: Gets a mutable, ordered list of pop-up elements.

PopupField.description: Represents how a geoelement's attribute (field) should be displayed in a popup.

FieldName.description: Gets or sets the field name.

Format.description: Gets or sets the format used to display the field.

IsEditable.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether users can edit the field.

IsVisible.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the field is visible in the popup.

Label.description: Gets or sets the field label. The field label (alias) can be overridden by the map author.

StringFieldOption.description: Gets or sets the type of input box (e.g. SingleLine, MultiLine) presented when editing the field.

Tooltip.description: Gets or sets a string providing hints for editors of the field. This string can provide a short description of the field and how editors should format or supply its value.

PopupFieldFormat.description: Represents the formatting of a field when displayed. Applies only to fields of type date or number (float, double, integer).

DateFormat.description: Gets or sets the format used to display a date field in a popup.

DecimalPlaces.description: Gets or sets the number of supported decimal places for displaying a numerical field in a popup.

UseThousandsSeparator.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a numerical field may use the thousands (or digit) separator when displayed in a popup.

PopupDateFormat.description: Format that controls how a date field is displayed in a popup.

PopupStringFieldOption.description: Type of input box presented when editing the field in a popup.

PopupMedia.description: Represents an image or a chart that is displayed in a pop-up for a GeoElement.

Caption.description: Gets or sets the caption that is displayed for the media.

Title.description: Gets or sets the title that is displayed for the media.

Type.description: Gets or sets the type of media.

Value.description: Gets or sets the media contents.

ImageRefreshInterval.description: Gets or sets the image refresh interval. This property is useful only for a pop-up media of type Image.

PopupMediaType.description: Type of media in a popup.

PopupMediaValue.description: Represents contents of an individual media element in a popup.

FieldNames.description: Gets a mutable list of Field which defines fields used in the chart.

ChartColors.description: Gets a mutable list of colors to be used in charts, where each "color" sequentially corresponds to a field in the FieldNames property.

LinkUrl.description: Gets or sets the link URL for an image.

NormalizeFieldName.description: Gets or sets the optional field used to normalize the chart.

SourceUrl.description: Gets or sets the source URL for an image.

TooltipFieldName.description: Gets or sets the tooltip field.

Data.description: Gets the attribute values for the pop-up media's fields defined in FieldNames. This property is populated when EvaluateExpressionsAsync is called.

Labels.description: Gets the user-friendly display names for the pop-up media's fields defined in FieldNames. This property is populated when EvaluateExpressionsAsync is called.

PopupRelatedFeaturesDefinition.description: Contains information about displaying related features in a popup.

ShowRelatedFeatures.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the popup should show features that are related to this popup's feature.

SortOrder.description: Gets an array of objects which dictate the order in which the relationships and related features in each relationship should be displayed.

PopupRelatedFeaturesSortOrder.description: Defines the order in which related features of a particular relationship are sorted for display.

OrderByField.description: Gets or sets the field in the related table by which the related features should be sorted for display.

RelationshipId.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the relationship for which related features should be sorted for display.

OrderBy.description: Represents an ordering in a query's order by clause.

FieldName.description: Gets or sets the name of the field being ordered.

Name.description: Gets the name of the layer content.

SublayerContents.description: Gets the sub layer contents of a layer content.

allOf.description: A table of features that typically represent real-world objects created from an ArcGIS map or feature service.

Item.description: Base class for PortalItem and LocalItem

ItemId.description: Gets or sets the unique id for this item.

Created.description: Gets the date the item was created.

Modified.description: Gets the date the item was modified.

Name.description: Gets the name of the item

Tags.description: Gets the mutable list of user defined tags that are words or short phrases that describe the item.

TermsOfUse.description: Gets or sets the terms of use of the item.

allOf.description: An item (a unit of content) stored in an ArcGIS portal, such as a layer, web map, package file, or map service.

Url.description: Gets the URL of this portal item.

Name.description: Gets or sets the name of this portal item.

TypeName.description: Gets the type name of this portal item.

Owner.description: Gets the username of the user who owns this portal item.

ServiceUrl.description: Gets the URL of the service that this portal item represents. Applies only to items that represent web-accessible resources such as map services.

Type.description: Gets the GIS content type of this portal item. A portal item's type cannot be changed once it has an item ID; create a new portal item if you wish to change the type.

TermsOfUse.description: Gets or sets the terms of use of this portal item.

Culture.description: Gets the item locale (language and country) information.

Size.description: Gets the size of the portal item.

RatingCount.description: Gets the number of ratings on the portal item.

AverageRating.description: Gets the average rating for this portal item.

ViewCount.description: Gets the number of views of this portal item.

Classification.description: Gets the classification information that describes the level of sensitivity for the item's content.

PortalInfo.description: Gets the details about this ArcGISPortal, such as the name, logo, featured items and supported protocols (http vs https).

User.description: Gets the current user. Available only to authenticated users after initialization.

CultureInfo.description: Gets the information that specifies culture-specific formatting to use when accessing ArcGISPortal content. Must be set using the appropriate CreateAsync method.

PortalInfo.description: Includes information such as the name, logo, featured items and supported protocols (http vs https) for this portal.

portalName.description: Gets the name of the portal.

id.description: Gets the id of the organization, if the user belongs to one.

name.description: Gets the name of the organization. In the case of non-organizational users of ArcGIS Online or a multi-tenant portal, this will be null.

description.description: Gets the description of the organization. In the case of non-organizational users of ArcGIS Online or a multi-tenant portal, this will be null.

customBaseUrl.description: Gets the custom base URL for the organization.

urlKey.description: Gets the portion of the URL's host component that identifies a specific organization subscription within a portal.

commentsEnabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether comments are enabled.

canSharePublic.description: Gets a value indicating whether members of the organization can share resources outside of the organization.

canShareBingPublic.description: Gets a flag indicating whether the bing key can be shared to the public and will be returned as part of a PortalInfo description.
